## Contract and outcomes

Capture the command by its catalog name while the document target is current. The optional StableRange and focus owner identify the intended target. An unavailable capture returns undefined. History targets route undo/redo through the existing history owner. CommandChain's published methods prepare one Rust commit; do not infer Tiptap chain helpers or promise a method absent from these declarations.

## Errors and recovery

A disabled command, invalid target, stale capture or read-only view cannot be treated as success. Release captures on dismissal and inspect returned command/commit outcomes. Peer and host-agent edits are not rewritten as local typing history.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

The linked qualified consumer exercises bold, search/reorder and shared history. It does not qualify every exported command or arbitrary chain combination.
